purpose: Cross-check previously published bilingual Firsts against full original Tamil Class 12 Economics PDF without claiming same-edition or whole-book verification
catalogue_edition: 2024 archived Tamil medium, pending verification of full internal imprint
selection_type: PDF page numbers are one-indexed PDF page indices, not asserted printed page numbers

targets.claim: 1969 first Economics prize co-winner Ragnar Frisch
targets.text_finding: Tamil edition mentions Ragnar Frisch as an econometrician; no 1969 first-prize sentence located by this search

targets.claim: Sveriges Riksbank oldest central bank founded in 1668
targets.text_finding: Visible Tamil passage calls Sweden's Riksbank the first central bank. It says 1897 was when the bank gained exclusive banknote-issue rights, not its foundation. The 1668 foundation date remains independently corroborated from Riksbank history.

targets.claim: Sir Osborne Smith first RBI Governor in 1935
targets.text_finding: Visible original Tamil source specifically calls Osborne Smith the first RBI Governor, in a dedicated RBI information box.

targets.claim: Sher Shah Suri issued Rupiya coin
targets.text_finding: Visible Tamil source's rupee-origin paragraph attributes first rupee coin issue to Sher Shah Suri, supporting narrower precursor framing.

targets.claim: First WTO Ministerial Conference Singapore in 1996
targets.text_finding: Tamil original's WTO passage identifies a first conference held in Singapore in 1996; visual excerpt confirms Singapore and year, while complete English/Tamil same-edition cross-check is pending.

unreviewed: Printed pages and figures, tables, all other school-book subjects/years, 2026 prescribed originals and full EN/TA equivalence still pending. Candidate keyword counts are not certified facts.

small_visual_excerpt_review.method: Five narrowly cropped rendered snippets of actual Tamil SCERT book text inspected; not whole pages/figures/exercises or complete book
